depth0To30Cm.description: Soil Mineral Nitrogen sampling value (kg N/ha) at depth 0cm to 30cm

depth30To60Cm.description: Soil Mineral Nitrogen sampling value (kg N/ha) at depth 30cm to 60cm

depth60To90Cm.description: Soil Mineral Nitrogen sampling value (kg N/ha) at depth 60cm to 90cm, note that this is an optional input and should only be provided when an Autumn season is provided under the SeasonId parameter - see Section 4 - Measurement Method for more details

RB209Models.RB209WebApi.Measurement.Requ.description: Inputs for Measurement Method Step 1 if the crop is Vegetables, Bulbs or Herbs

depthCm.description: The depth in that SMN measurement was taken at (cm)

depthValue.description: Soil Mineral Nitrogen sampling value (kg N/ha)

shootNumber.description: The Crop Nitrogen value calculated from the Shoot Number Method (shoot number/m2). Only relevant for winter cereal crops.

greenAreaIndex.description: The Crop Nitrogen value calculated from the Green Area Index Method (GAI). Only relevant for winter oilseed rape.

cropHeight.description: The Crop Nitrogen value calculated from the Crop Height Method (cm). Only relevant for winter oilseed rape.

adjustment.description: The Crop Nitrogen adjustment value based on local knowledge, note that this is an optional value and should be between 0 and 60kg N/ha. For further information see sections 4 and 5 - Make an adjustment for net mineralisable nitrogen. If you are providing this value, do not provide a value for OrganicMatterPercentage.

organicMatterPercentage.description: The Organic Matter Percentage value based on local knowledge, note that this is an optional value and should be between 0 and 100%. Values less than 4% will be defaulted to 4%, while values greater than 10% will be defaulted to 10%. For further information see sections 4 and 5 - Make an adjustment for net mineralisable nitrogen. If you are providing this value, do not provide a value for Adjustment.

summerRainfallAverage.description: The Summer Rainfall Average value returned.

winterRainfallAverage.description: The Winter Rainfall Average value returned.

cropOrder.description:
The order of this crop in the field for the year. If there is only a single crop, then this value must be 1,
otherwise it must be 1 or 2 based on the position of the crop during the year.

cropGroupId.description: The crop group id of the crop in the field.

cropTypeId.description: The crop type id of the crop in the field.

cropInfo1Id.description: The crop info 1 id of the crop in the field.

cropInfo2Id.description: The crop info 2 id of the crop in the field. This value is required for arable cereals crops only, for all other crops this value should be null.

sowingDate.description: The date that the crop in the field was sown.

expectedYield.description: The expected yield of the crop in the field, in t/ha. If not provided for crops that require a yield value, then a default value will be used instead.

totals.description:
Boolean value used to determine whether to include a breakdown of each recommendation value in the returned data set. 
True: just return total values, False: also include the breakdown values.

referenceValue.description:
Optional reference value to identify a particular call to the endpoint, to aid with debugging.
Only letters, numbers and the following symbols #:-() are allowed, up to a maximum length of 75 characters.
We recommend passing in a global unique identifier (GUID). Please do not include any sensitive information.

fieldType.description: The type of field: arable, grass, or both (where there are multiple crops in the field in the same year where one is arable and the other grass).

multipleCrops.description: Whether the field has just a single crop grown in the current crop year (false), or multiple crops in the current crop year (true).

arable.description:
If the field has an arable crop in the current crop year: The arable parameters of the field.
With multiple crops, it is possible to have more than one arable crop in the same crop year.

harvestYear.description: The year that the field is harvested in.

rainfallAverage.description: The average annual rainfall on the field, in millimetres.

excessWinterRainfall.description: The excess winter rainfall on the field, in millimetres.

excessWinterRainfallManuallyEntered.description:
Set this value to true if the ExcessWinterRainfall value has been manually entered by the user. 
If the ExcessWinterRainfall value provided has been calculated from a postcode lookup, then this value should be set to false.

mannerManures.description:
If you want to provide outputs calculated from Manner, this should be set to true, if you want to provide values to calculate organic materials from RB209 section 2,
or you want to provide neither, then this should be set to false. If no value is provided, this will default to false.

organicMaterials.description: Details of any organic materials applied to the field for the current crop.

countryId.description: The country that the field is in.

RB209Models.RB209WebApi.Recommendation.R.description: Fresh weight yield item for Scotland fields with specific sward types

position.description: The position in the sequence - note: all items in the defoliation sequence need to be provided here, including an establishment item if relevant.

freshWeightYield.description: The fresh weight yield of the item in the defoliation sequence. If the item is an establishment item, then the yield value should be set to null.

RB209Models.RB209WebApi.Recommendation.R.description: New functionality replacing the legacy Grassland inputs: If the field has a grassland crop in the current crop year: The grassland parameters of the field.

cropOrder.description:
The order of this crop in the field for the year. If there is only a single crop, then this value must be 1,
otherwise it must be 1 or 2 based on the position of the crop during the year.

swardTypeId.description: The sward type id of the grass crop in the field.

swardManagementId.description: The sward management id of the grass crop in the field.

defoliationSequenceId.description: The defoliation sequence id of the grass crop in the field.

grassGrowthClassId.description: The grass growth class (GGC) id of the grass crop in the field - for England & Wales fields.

siteClassId.description: The site class id of the grass crop in the field - for Scottish fields.

yield.description:
For England & Wales fields, as well as Scotland fields where the sward type is 'grass with low clover', the dry matter yield (whole number) across the whole grass crop in the field. 
If you are providing a value for this, the values for 'freshWeightYield' should not be provided.

freshWeightYields.description: For Scotland fields only, where the sward type is either 'grass with high clover' or 'red clover', the fresh weight yield of the field should be split across the defoliations of the grass crop in the field. If you are providing values for this, the value for 'yield' should not be provided.

seasonId.description: If the first item in the grass sequence is an establishment, then the id of whether this is an autumn or spring establishment. If there is no establishment, then the id of none.
